Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1416

New nodes

Each of these is Kento's own node. A .nk script gets a group of standard nodes that renders the same.

  • GamutCompress (Color): out-of-gamut colors brought back inside smoothly, or hard-limited to the gamut's edge. The reference values are for ACEScg. Invert undoes it.
  • ChromaticAberration (Transform): a lens's color fringing added, or taken out with a negative amount. Red and blue are scaled about the lens center.
  • RangeMatte (Keyer): a matte of the shadows, midtones or highlights, from the same ranges a ColorCorrect uses.
  • PositionMatte (Keyer): a matte of a sphere or a box in the scene, from a world position pass.
  • LayerFilter (Channel): keeps or removes layers whose names match wildcard patterns.
  • TimeDisplace (Time): each pixel shows another frame, picked by a map. Use it for slit-scans and time-smears.
  • FrameRepair (Time): bad frames replaced by the nearest good frame before or after, or a blend of the two.
  • TemporalSmooth (Time): each frame a weighted average of the frames around it, to take out flicker and boil.

Viewer and panels

  • Guides: each guide, and each aspect's mask and lines, has its own color.
  • Reformat's panel shows only the controls for the chosen type. Width and height are in pixels, with an exact width and height option.

.nk scripts

  • A .nk now declares the comp's own layers (P, N and the like), so they read back wherever the script is opened.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1405

Deep

  • New: DeepExpression (an expression a channel on every sample: color, front and back depth), DeepReformat, DeepFromFrames, and DeepToPoints (kept for scripts; its points aren't drawn yet).
  • DeepFromImage drops samples with no alpha, as it should.

New nodes and commands

  • MatchGrade (Color): Analyze grades the source to look like the target, as a 3D LUT or a CDL.
  • Edit > Node > Split and join views: the selected node made once a view, so each eye can be set on its own.

Viewer

  • Stereo shown Interlaced (alternate rows) or Flicker (alternate frames), beside Anaglyph and Side by side.
  • Compare > Contact sheet: every input connected to the Viewer in a grid.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1393

Fixes

  • The Viewer showed nothing for a stereo comp (builds 1380 to 1392): it shows the comp's views again.

Viewer

  • Bar 2's saturation works: the picture shown grayer or stronger, for the eye only.
  • In a stereo comp the view menu also offers Anaglyph (left in red, right in cyan) and Side by side.
